title: Does entry quantity set how MUCH surface life a fort sees, or only which species are eligible? E36 showed that on the cavern layer frequency divides a fixed spawn budget rather than setting volume — a 25-fold cut moved one pair to zero while the total held. The same discriminator is applied here to the surface layer's own lever: the roster is run at in_season_qty 200 against 20, a tenfold difference in every managed land entry, same species, same seasons. If total surface arrivals scale with it, the abundance slider sets volume; if they hold, it only gates. A season, two replicates each.
fork: Is the abundance slider a volume control or only an eligibility gate.

predictions.expects: total surface arrivals rise clearly with in_season_qty — roughly with the tenfold difference, or at least unmistakably

predictions.model: quantity only gates (a shared budget, as the caverns have)
predictions.expects: total surface arrivals are about the same in both arms; the pool numbers differ tenfold and the map does not
no difference between 20 and 200, but both far above what a zeroed roster gives — the lever is on/off with a wide flat middle

kill_criterion: a clear difference in total surface arrivals between the arms, 2 of 2, makes abundance a volume control; no difference makes it an eligibility gate and the GUI slider needs rewording
culling: drop a replicate on any changed save

arms.name: qty_200
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.layers.land=true; cfg.layers.water=false; cfg.layers.cavern=false; cfg.in_season_qty=200; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1 end end; local a=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('e24: in_season_qty=200 — %d allowed, %d assigned, %d entries activated'):format(n,a,act))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local by=sw.WILD.countByLayer(); local cz=0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isCitizen(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) then cz=cz+1 end end; local q=0,0; local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do if sw.managedPop(pop, rs, {land=true}) and sw.layerOf(pop)=='land' then q=q+pop.quantity end end; print(('e24: land=%d water=%d cavern=%d deep=%d citizens=%d land_pool_qty=%d day=%d'):format(by.land,by.water,by.cavern,by.deep,cz,q,math.floor(df.global.cur_year_tick/1200)))
